note: Live paper experiments. The three hourly ones use the settings the walk-forward research chose in its most recent fold (research/report.json, 2026-10-18); none showed a validated edge. The two daily ones (daily_btc, daily_eth) come from a 2018-2026 daily-candle backtest across 101 markets; they trade at most a few times a month, so months of live results can't confirm them. All run to collect live evidence, not because they're expected to win.

experiments.description: EMA trend experiment: hold BTC while the 48h EMA is above the 168h EMA
experiments.research_note: Unseen Jul 2025 - Oct 2026: -23.1% (BTC -23.1%), max drawdown -43.1%, 47 trades, beat BTC in 4 of 5 quarters

experiments.description: Breakout experiment: buy a new 7-day high, sell on a new 3-day low
experiments.research_note: Unseen Jul 2025 - Oct 2026: -13.1% (BTC -23.1%), max drawdown -34.7%, 36 trades, beat BTC in 2 of 5 quarters

experiments.description: Dip-buy experiment: buy when RSI drops below 25 in an uptrend, sell when it recovers above 60
experiments.research_note: Unseen Jul 2025 - Oct 2026: -1.9% (BTC -23.1%), max drawdown -3.9%, only 4 trades in 15 months, mostly in cash

experiments.description: Daily BTC trend experiment: hold BTC while its price is above its 100-day average, 10% stop-loss
experiments.research_note: Backtest Jan 2018 - Nov 2026 on daily candles, settings fixed in advance and not tuned: +37.4%/yr vs +20.7%/yr for holding BTC, worst drop -53% vs -81%, 57 trades. Most nearby settings (50 to 150 days) also beat holding. Not yet confirmed live.

experiments.description: Daily ETH trend experiment: hold ETH while its price is above its 100-day average, 10% stop-loss
experiments.research_note: Backtest Jan 2018 - Nov 2026 on daily candles, settings fixed in advance and not tuned: +32.6%/yr vs +12.4%/yr for holding ETH, worst drop -71% vs -94%, 63 trades. Not yet confirmed live.
